rubric_content.text_property: The conversation ends with the user's underlying goal fulfilled using numbers from actual BigQuery tool results, not invented figures. For progressive_disclosure_yearly_granularity: a trend for Mary in California (yearly granularity is acceptable; the table has no monthly data). For context_carryover_gender_filter: a girls-only top 5 for Texas 1990.

The agent never fabricates monthly data from the yearly usa_1910_2013 table; if the user asks for a monthly trend, the agent states the table's granularity is yearly and offers the yearly alternative.
Follow-up questions are resolved against conversation context (table, state, year, name from earlier turns) without asking the user to repeat information already provided.
Every SELECT executed during the conversation names explicit columns (no SELECT *) and includes a LIMIT of at most 1000 rows, per the custom-sql-guidelines skill.
The agent uses the read-only SQL tool for SELECT queries and does not re-run identical queries or re-discover metadata it already fetched in earlier turns.
